create_memory_insert_new: create a new user memory record in the database with content and user_id
update_memory_by_id_and_user_id: update an existing memory record by its id and user_id with new content
read_memories_by_user_id: read all memory records filtered by a specific user_id
delete_memory_by_id_and_user_id: delete a specific memory record by its id and user_id
delete_memories_by_user_id: delete all memory records for a given user_id
